SITUATION
On a rain-damp Colombo roadside, Kasun has recovered the phone Anudi dropped without noticing. He is already running after her beside his small food three-wheeler.

PEOPLE
Kasun is left-center, three-quarter toward the camera and facing screen right, looking ahead off lens toward Anudi, who remains unseen. He wears a faded teal short-sleeved cotton shirt, charcoal straight-leg trousers, plain dark sandals and a clean dark-brown waist apron tied at the back. His right hand holds the recovered smartphone low beside his waist, and his empty left arm is bent. He carries practical urgency and friendly concern.

ACTION & DIALOGUE
[0-1s] Kasun continues his short, practical run toward screen right, keeping the smartphone secure in his right hand beside his waist. His gaze stays on Anudi ahead as he draws breath.

[1-5s] Kasun, to Anudi, friendly-polite and projected over the street noise without alarm, intent on getting her attention, lifting his eyebrows slightly while keeping his eyes ahead:
"මිස්! මිස්! ඔයාගේ ෆෝන් එක!"

[5-6s] His lips close and he takes another breath while continuing right. His eyes remain on Anudi ahead, and the phone stays visible in his right hand at his side.

They speak casual, everyday spoken Sinhala, the way people really talk in a Sri Lankan teledrama: not an interview, not a speech, nobody looks at the camera. Only these words are spoken, only by the people named; English words in a line are said as Sri Lankans say them.

CAMERA
The camera travels smoothly right beside Kasun in an eye-level medium shot as he calls, the roadside sliding left behind him, ending in the same three-quarter framing with the phone at his side.

SOUND
Light rain, low distant traffic and quick natural footfalls beneath his voice. No music.

RULES
Hands: Kasun holds the smartphone in one hand. The umbrella is not in this frame. Clean frame: no captions, no subtitles, no watermarks. Text the description spells out (on a screen, a sign, a letter or a page) is rendered exactly as written; no other lettering is invented.
